Take a shelter dog out for the day in Michigan

Want to rent or borrow a dog in Michigan? These shelters let you take an adoptable dog on a day trip, hike or sleepover for free. 24 shelter programs in Michigan, 14 of them open to the public. Cities include Adrian, Ann Arbor, Battle Creek, Dearborn, Detroit, Farmington Hills, Grand Rapids, Harbor Springs and more.

ShelterDayOut is a free directory. We don't run outings or handle bookings; each shelter sets its own rules. Listings are checked monthly, but details change, so confirm with the shelter before you go.

Ready to adopt? ShelterAdoption, our sister site, lists every shelter near you plus upcoming adoption events.
